advancements.nomosiki.root.title: Nomosiki
advancements.nomosiki.root.description: Armies, squads, and clans. The next steps show how to use them.
advancements.nomosiki.faction.title: Your Banner
advancements.nomosiki.faction.descriptio: Create a faction with O: you need a patterned banner. Or accept an invite into someone else's clan.
advancements.nomosiki.hire.title: Garrison
advancements.nomosiki.hire.description: At your clan's province marker, order ashigaru. The province needs a level, 10 copper coins, and food from the granary or your inventory. The order takes about three minutes, then the squad holds at the marker.
advancements.nomosiki.follow.title: Follow Me
advancements.nomosiki.follow.description: Right-click your soldier with an empty hand to toggle follow. A province garrison does not follow you on its own.
advancements.nomosiki.equip.title: Kit Out
advancements.nomosiki.equip.description: Shift-right-click your soldier to open equipment. Give him a weapon or armor.
advancements.nomosiki.order.title: An Order
advancements.nomosiki.order.description: The garrison is already holding at the marker. T opens the tactical camera, right-click marches, F holds again.
advancements.nomosiki.formation.title: Formation
advancements.nomosiki.formation.descript: On the command screen (R), change the squad's shape: line, square, wedge, or ring.
advancements.nomosiki.stance.title: Stance
advancements.nomosiki.stance.description: On that screen, pick a combat mode: passive, neutral, aggressive, or raid. The squad list is J.
advancements.nomosiki.bombard.title: Volley
advancements.nomosiki.bombard.descriptio: Use the Bombard button on archers or musketeers, then click the ground. The squad keeps firing at the zone and stays in place.
advancements.nomosiki.waypoint.title: A Route
advancements.nomosiki.waypoint.descripti: Set a waypoint for the squad in tactical mode. The column walks on without a fresh order at every step.
advancements.nomosiki.attack_order.title: Attack
advancements.nomosiki.attack_order.descr: Ctrl-right-click in the tactical camera orders an attack zone. You can also send them after an enemy squad or player.
advancements.nomosiki.first_blood.title: First Blood
advancements.nomosiki.first_blood.descri: One of your soldiers must defeat a mob or an enemy fighter.
advancements.nomosiki.kills_25.title: Blooded
advancements.nomosiki.kills_100.title: Field of Battle
advancements.nomosiki.company.title: Company
advancements.nomosiki.company.descriptio: Gather 48 soldiers in one squad. A single province order cannot do that: on J, move people in from several garrisons.
advancements.nomosiki.army.title: Army
advancements.nomosiki.army.description: One squad of 128 soldiers, the roster cap. It takes many province orders.
advancements.nomosiki.four_roles.title: Four Arms
advancements.nomosiki.four_roles.descrip: Keep infantry, an archer, cavalry, and a nomad in one squad. Province orders are one type at a time, so combine them with J.
advancements.nomosiki.all_branches.title: Every Branch
advancements.nomosiki.all_branches.descr: Hire every branch through a province. British troops and musketeers need Catholicism, Spanish troops Protestantism, monks Buddhism, and ninja folk religion. Ninja, samurai musketeers, British musketeers, and monk cavalry unlock at level 5.
advancements.nomosiki.alliance.title: Alliance
advancements.nomosiki.alliance.descripti: Accept an alliance offer from another faction. Requests and replies are in the clan menu, key O.
advancements.nomosiki.war.title: War
advancements.nomosiki.war.description: Declare war on another faction from the O menu or with /faction. Allies cannot be attacked this way.
advancements.nomosiki.peace.title: Peace
advancements.nomosiki.peace.description: Offer peace to an enemy faction, or accept theirs. While the war lasts, the clans' soldiers fight on their own.
advancements.nomosiki.duel.title: Duel
advancements.nomosiki.duel.description: Challenge a player with K or /duel. They have 2 minutes to answer, and the fight is followed by a day of cooldown. Win.
advancements.nomosiki.duel_five.title: Duelist
advancements.nomosiki.duel_five.descript: Win 5 duels. The day-long cooldown makes this a long goal.
advancements.nomosiki.give_squad.title: Clan Banner
advancements.nomosiki.give_squad.descrip: Hand one of your squads to a clanmate. Transfers are closed during wartime.
advancements.nomosiki.raid.title: Raid
advancements.nomosiki.raid.description: Win a fight while the squad is in raid stance. Raid strikes anyone who is not an ally.
advancements.nomosiki.cascade.title: Cascade
advancements.nomosiki.cascade.descriptio: Declare a war that pulls a military ally of either side into the fight.
advancements.nomosiki.ninja_mark.title: Ninja Mark
advancements.nomosiki.ninja_mark.descrip: Mark an enemy player on the map with a ninja squad. Ninja are hired from a level-5 folk-religion province.
advancements.nomosiki.siege.title: A Volley
advancements.nomosiki.siege.description: A province artillerist must fire a Siege Machines gun.
advancements.nomosiki.helm.title: At the Helm
advancements.nomosiki.helm.description: A province captain takes the helm of a zk-ship and sails it on the squad's order.
advancements.nomosiki.sixteen.title: Sixteen Banners
advancements.nomosiki.sixteen.descriptio: Give one order to sixteen of your squads at once.
